derived_competitive_set._derivation_method: Derived from the PRODUCT CATEGORY (Bakery: packaged bread and buns for home consumption), not the owner's list. Price spread in this category: moderate (value loaf vs artisan). Tiers follow the eight-tier frame: default/no-purchase, cheap substitute, direct set, category incumbent (the rungs of the customer's mental ladder), adjacent crossover, indirect, and new entrants derived from public opening records.
